## genin cowplot:
phylo trees colored by genin clusters (raw) for all 8 segments.
nrow = 1, ncol=8 (one column per segment)
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
img_dir<-"../2026-05-13_out"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

segs<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")

# helper
img_to_gg<-function(img_path){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# build combined grid
save_grid<-function(img_dir,out_dir,segs,
                    width=12,height=2.7,dpi=600){

  paths<-path(img_dir,paste0(segs,"_geninClusters.tiff"))

  if(any(!file_exists(paths))){
    message("Missing:\n",paste(paths[!file_exists(paths)],collapse="\n"))
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=length(segs),nrow=1,
                  labels=NA)

  out_name<-"allsegs_geninClusters.png"
  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)

  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=width,height=height,dpi=dpi,bg="white")
  out_file
}

written<-save_grid(img_dir=img_dir,out_dir=out_dir,segs=segs)
if(!is.na(written))message("Wrote: ",written)
```
## just HA
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
img_dir<-"../2026-05-13_out"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

# helper
img_to_gg<-function(img_path){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

path_ha<-path(img_dir,"HA_geninClusters.tiff")

if(!file_exists(path_ha)){
  message("Missing: ",path_ha)
}else{

  grid<-img_to_gg(path_ha)

  out_name<-"HA_geninClusters.png"
  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)

  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=2.5,height=4.2,dpi=300,bg="white")
  message("Wrote: ",out_file)
}
```

## all segs filled in genin labels on trees
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
img_dir<-"../2026-05-13_out/"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

segs<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")

# helper
img_to_gg<-function(img_path){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# fixed filenames
files<-paste0(segs,"_geninClusters.tiff")
paths<-path(img_dir,files)

if(any(!file_exists(paths))){
  message("Missing:\n",paste(paths[!file_exists(paths)],collapse="\n"))
}else{

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=4,nrow=2,
                  labels=NA)

  out_name<-"allsegs_geninClusters_comp.png"
  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)

  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=10,height=7.5,dpi=300,bg="white")
  message("Wrote: ",out_file)
}
```


## genin: distribution of within-cluster patristic distances
```{r}

  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# fixed filenames
files<-paste0(segs,"_patdist_withinclades.tiff")
paths<-path(img_dir,files)

if(any(!file_exists(paths))){
  message("Missing:\n",paste(paths[!file_exists(paths)],collapse="\n"))
}else{

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=4,nrow=2,
                  labels=NA)

}
```
